name: PAN-OS High-Risk URL-Filtering Alert
query: event.dataset:"panw.panos" and panw.panos.type:"THREAT" and event.kind:alert and event.action:url_filtering and panw.panos.action:alert and panw.panos.application.risk_level:(4 or 5) and not (panw.panos.ruleset:"Allow_Basic_Web_Functionality" and panw.panos.url_category_list:"low-risk")
